cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the sofa down. The keys have gone invisible because you're angry. Remember how I taught you to ask calmly instead of grabbing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've heard you. Good, now use the quiet voice we practised. Put the cushion down and apologise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologise, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's still grabbing with your eyes. You used to call that compromise too. No checking; tell them we trust them to come out when they're ready.

reason: Make prior teaching determine the response, and distinguish surrendering ordinary explanations from hiding culpability or just redirecting why questions. Repair explicit contradictions and give hope scenes real next steps and visible withholding.
